card.name: Dose-related words in dosing and overdose text
card.fires_on: The space after 'every' in dosing intervals, the end of 'theophylline' or 'atenolol' before dose or overdose words, and 'adequate' after 'ensure' in overdose management text.

modes.label: Adequate oxygenation
modes.description: The word 'adequate' right after 'ensure' in overdose management steps.
modes.example: establish and maintain an airway and ensure<< adequate>> oxygenation and ventilation.

modes.label: Ending of drug names
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name such as theophylline or atenolol, followed by dose or overdose terms.

modes.label: Space after every
modes.description: The space after 'every' in a dosing table before the hours.
modes.example: Dicloxacillin 125 mg every<< >>6 hours 250 mg every
